commands.name: show
commands.description: Open the iris pane. /show <n> selects figure n; /show <path> shows a file.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Show a diagram or image to the user in the iris side pane, and get back a PNG of what they see. Use it whenever a picture helps the user follow along: architecture or data flow (mermaid), graphs (dot), figures you compiled (.tex, .typ, .pdf, .svg), plots and sample data (.png, .jpg). Reuse an `id` to add a new version of the same figure while iterating on it. The pane is a narrow sidebar: prefer top-down layouts (flowchart TB, rankdir=TB) over long left-to-right ones. After every call, Read the returned PNG and say what is actually visible (layout, labels, anything off) before claiming anything about the figure.

children: No figures yet. Claude adds them with the show tool; you can type /show path/to/file.
